news.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
news.detail: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday. Three of the attacks targeted…

news.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
news.detail: Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti, an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution. The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE…
